title: FastMCTS: A Simple Sampling Strategy for Data Synthesis
authors_zh: Peiji Li、Kai Lv、Yunfan Shao、Yichuan Ma、Linyang Li、Xiaoqing Zheng、Xipeng Qiu、Qipeng Guo
paper_type_zh: 树搜索数据合成与过程监督配方
best_for_zh: 研究推理数据合成、搜索树轨迹、终端验证、步骤偏好与 token 预算审计的读者
one_line: Reuses reasoning prefixes in an MCTS-inspired tree and backs up terminal LLM judgments to construct math SFT paths and step/branch preference pairs under a token budget.
在 MCTS 风格的共享树中复用推理前缀，并把终端 LLM 判断回传为节点值，从而构造数学 SFT 路径与步骤/分支偏好对。
why: Connects search allocation, terminal verification, tree-derived process labels, SFT, and DPO while making the label assumptions and missing experimental data auditable.
inclusion_reason: Concrete tree-based recipe that converts terminally judged math rollouts into correct-path SFT records and backed-value step/branch preference pairs under explicit token accounting.

title: Problem
问题
html: Independent rejection sampling regenerates a complete solution for every attempt. Long shared prefixes consume tokens repeatedly, and the number of accepted paths concentrates on easy problems. A tree can reuse prefixes and redirect expansion toward uncertain or promising states, but ordinary MCTS simulation is expensive for language models and terminal success does not automatically reveal which intermediate step was sound. FastMCTS asks whether an MCTS-inspired construction substrate can produce more useful math traces under comparable generation-token budgets and turn its tree statistics into SFT and preference objects without a separately trained process reward model.

独立拒绝采样每次都重新生成完整解答，长公共前缀会反复消耗 token，而且通过筛选的路径容易集中在简单题上。搜索树可以复用前缀，并把扩展转向不确定或更有希望的状态；但常规 MCTS 模拟对语言模型成本较高，终端成功也不能自动指出中间哪一步正确。FastMCTS 研究能否以 MCTS 风格的构造底座，在可比生成 token 预算下得到更多有用数学轨迹，并在不另训过程奖励模型的情况下，把树统计转成 SFT 与偏好数据对象。 关于《FastMCTS: A Simple Sampling Strategy for Data Synthesis》：审阅时应把问题边界落在可复用的数据对象与反馈合同，而不是论文标题或榜单分数；输入来源、生成者、输出字段、筛选规则与最终判定器必须分开核对，未公开部分保持为未知。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The root stores a math problem and reference answer. A partial solution is a state; the next numbered natural-language step is an action and node. From a selected node, the generator completes one or more trajectories. FastMCTS splits every generated completion at Step n markers and retains all segments as a branch, so simulation tokens become reusable tree data rather than disposable rollouts. Terminal trajectories receive a binary LLM judgment, which is backed up to visits, wins, and win_count / visit_count at each ancestor.

The same tree yields two training objects. Verifier-accepted complete paths become SFT records, selected across different branches to increase diversity. For preference data, a child with any successful descendant is treated as chosen-capable; a zero-score child is treated as rejected. Repeatedly visited zero-score children form step-level pairs, while once-visited children form branch-level pairs because their local step is considered uncertain. The paper reports up to five pairs per tree, producing 152K and 215K preference records on its two hard-math mixtures, but those experimental records and trees are not released.

根节点保存数学题与参考答案；部分解答是状态，下一个带编号的自然语言推理步骤是动作和节点。生成器从选中节点继续完成一条或多条轨迹。FastMCTS 按 Step n 标记切分每次生成结果，并把全部片段保留为树分支，使模拟 token 成为可复用的树数据，而不是用后即弃的 rollout。终端轨迹由 LLM 给出二元判断，再向祖先回传访问次数、获胜次数与 win_count / visit_count。

同一棵树产生两类训练对象。通过验证的完整路径作为 SFT 记录，并优先从不同分支选择以增加多样性。构造偏好数据时，只要子节点存在成功后继，就把它视为可选分支；分数为零的子节点视为拒绝分支。被多次访问仍为零分的子节点构成步骤级偏好对，只访问一次的子节点则构成分支级偏好对，因为其局部步骤仍不确定。论文称每棵树最多取五对，在两个困难数学混合上得到 15.2 万与 21.5 万条偏好记录，但这些实验记录与树没有发布。

title: Method
方法
html:
For training synthesis, 46,000 English problems are drawn from NuminaMath, MetaMath, and InternLM-Math train, and 50,000 Chinese high-school problems are collected from the internet. Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct first produces five solutions per problem; 100%-pass questions are removed. Keyword rules exclude proof, show-that, find-all, URL, and image cases; broken or incomplete formatting is removed; hashes are deduplicated and reported evaluation overlaps excluded. The resulting mixtures are called EN Math Hard and CN High School Math Hard, but their manifests are not public.

Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct generates step-formatted solutions with temperature 1 through SGLang and randomly composed few-shot examples. Selection uses UCT plus two changes. Adaptive Stay may expand an internal node when its value is very low or high rather than always descending to a leaf. Dynamic Exploration multiplies the UCT exploration constant by the current node score after repeated visits. Expansion and simulation are merged: root expansion uses degree 3, later expansion degree 2, and every completed simulation is retained. The main synthesis uses 16 iterations; efficiency sweeps use 4-20 iterations and expansion degree 1-2.

The same Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model judges each complete solution against the standard answer. The prompt asks whether the final answer matches and is not guessed or vague; it does not independently verify every intermediate step. Three samples must agree, and disagreements trigger another round until unanimity. Output length is capped at 32 tokens, but the retry count has no published or implemented cap. Binary terminal outcomes are backed up to node values.

Qwen2.5-7B is trained for three SFT epochs with maximum length 4096, global batch 32, learning rate 1e-5, and 0.1 warmup ratio; the best validation checkpoint is selected. Branch-DPO then trains three epochs with batch 16, learning rate 1e-6, beta 0.4, AdamW, cosine scheduling, and 0.1 warmup. The public processors serialize accepted paths and pair children using the backed-score heuristic, but the checked example configuration uses 32B, one judge sample, and eight iterations rather than the paper's main setup.

训练数据合成使用 4.6 万道英语题，来源为 NuminaMath、MetaMath 与 InternLM-Math 训练集；另有 5 万道从互联网收集的中文高中题。Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 先为每题生成五个解答，通过率 100% 的题被删除。关键词规则排除证明、show-that、find-all、URL 和图像题；格式损坏或不完整的题被删除；随后按哈希去重并排除作者声明的评测重叠。所得混合称为 EN Math Hard 与 CN High School Math Hard，但未公开清单。

Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 通过 SGLang、以温度 1 和随机组合的 few-shot 示例生成分步解答。选择阶段采用 UCT 并作两项修改：Adaptive Stay 允许在节点值很低或很高时直接扩展内部节点，而非总是下降到叶节点；Dynamic Exploration 在多次访问后用当前节点分数缩放 UCT 探索常数。扩展与模拟被合并：根扩展度为 3，后续扩展度为 2，每条完成的模拟都保留在树中。主合成设置为 16 次迭代；效率扫描使用 4-20 次迭代与 1-2 的扩展度。

同一个 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 根据标准答案判断完整解答。提示要求终局答案匹配且不是猜测或含糊回答，并不独立检查每个中间步骤。三次采样必须一致；若不一致则重新判断，直至全票一致。判断输出最长 32 token，但论文和实现都没有给出重试上限。二元终端结果随后回传为节点值。

Qwen2.5-7B 进行三轮 SFT，最大长度 4096、全局批量 32、学习率 1e-5、预热比例 0.1，并按验证表现选最佳检查点。Branch-DPO 再训练三轮，批量 16、学习率 1e-6、beta 0.4，使用 AdamW、余弦调度与 0.1 预热。公开处理脚本能序列化通过路径，并按回传分数启发式构造偏好对；但审计到的示例配置使用 32B、单次判断和八次迭代，并非论文主设置。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under the paper's training-synthesis accounting, FastMCTS uses slightly fewer average generated tokens and obtains more accepted paths per problem. On EN Math Hard it reports 26.2K tokens and 5.88 correct paths versus rejection sampling's 27.8K and 3.46; on CN High School Math Hard, 17.4K and 13.70 versus 18.2K and 8.15. The abstract's more general headline is over 30% more correct paths as token generation scales. This is not a claim of 30% lower token cost.

For the English mixture with at most 16 training trajectories per problem, Qwen2.5-7B trained on rejection-sampling data averages 52.7 across nine benchmarks; FastMCTS SFT averages 55.6, a 2.9-point gain. Adding 152K Branch-DPO pairs reaches 56.6, which is the 3.9-point headline relative to rejection sampling. The Chinese table reports smaller, benchmark-dependent changes. Additional 3B/7B comparisons improve the reported average but include individual regressions. These results support the complete synthesis-and-training setup under the paper's budgets; they do not validate each backed node or preference label.

The official repository materially supports the recipe: it includes tree classes, asynchronous generation and evaluation, SFT serialization, Branch-DPO pair construction, training scripts, and examples. Reproduction remains partial because paper-matched configs, manifests, outputs, checkpoints, seeds, pinned dependencies, and a license are absent.

按论文训练数据合成的计费方式，FastMCTS 平均生成 token 略少，而每题得到的通过路径更多。EN Math Hard 上为 26.2K token、5.88 条正确路径，拒绝采样为 27.8K、3.46；CN High School Math Hard 上为 17.4K、13.70，拒绝采样为 18.2K、8.15。摘要更宽泛的结论是：随着生成 token 增加，正确路径多出 30% 以上；这并不等于 token 成本降低 30%。

在英语混合、每题最多 16 条训练轨迹的设置中，使用拒绝采样数据训练的 Qwen2.5-7B 在九个基准上的平均分为 52.7，FastMCTS SFT 为 55.6，即提升 2.9 分；再加入 15.2 万条 Branch-DPO 偏好对后达到 56.6，相对拒绝采样提升 3.9 分。中文表中的变化更小且因基准而异。额外 3B/7B 对比提高了报告平均分，但个别基准也有下降。这些结果支持论文预算下的完整合成与训练设置，不能验证每个回传节点或偏好标签。

官方仓库为配方提供了实质支持：包含树结构、异步生成与评估、SFT 序列化、Branch-DPO 偏好构造、训练脚本和示例。但缺少与论文匹配的配置、清单、输出、检查点、种子、锁定依赖和许可证，因此复现仍是部分的。

title: Novelty
新意
html: FastMCTS treats a search tree as an offline data-construction object, not merely an inference decoder. Its distinctive efficiency move is to cache every simulated continuation as step nodes, so later expansion reuses prefixes rather than regenerating full paths. Adaptive Stay and score-scaled exploration allocate the token budget across problem difficulty, while one retained tree supplies accepted SFT paths and heuristic step/branch preference pairs. The method therefore links token accounting, search topology, terminal verification, and downstream supervision. It does not introduce a new mathematical verifier, and its “step-level supervision” is derived from terminal outcomes and search coverage rather than direct step annotation.

FastMCTS 把搜索树视为离线数据构造对象，而不只是推理解码器。其核心效率设计是把每条模拟续写都缓存为步骤节点，使后续扩展复用前缀，而非重新生成完整路径。Adaptive Stay 与按节点分数缩放的探索机制在不同难度题目间分配 token 预算；同一棵保留树又能产生通过验证的 SFT 路径和启发式步骤/分支偏好对。因此，该方法把 token 计费、搜索拓扑、终端验证与下游监督连接起来。它没有提出新的数学验证器，所谓“步骤级监督”也来自终端结果与搜索覆盖，而不是对每一步的直接标注。 关于《FastMCTS: A Simple Sampling Strategy for Data Synthesis》：创新性应按可操作的数据变换判断：新增了什么对象、筛选器或反馈合同，以及它与常见蒸馏、拒绝采样或结果验证有何区别。仅扩大样本量或报告更高分数不足以单独证明数据方法创新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The supervision contract is weaker than the label names suggest. The verifier prompt focuses on final-answer agreement, and the preference recipe assumes that a correct final result makes every preceding step correct. A zero-score node can be underexplored rather than wrong; shared generator/verifier family errors can survive unanimous judging; and unbounded consensus retries can bias cost and termination. Prefix reuse saves generation but may correlate trajectories and reduce diversity, which the authors identify as unresolved.

The data lineage is incomplete. Exact English proportions, Chinese web URLs and rights, item manifests, semantic decontamination, seeds, splits, and paper-run hashes are unavailable. The code repository has no license, uses unpinned dependencies, and its example settings do not reproduce the main paper configuration. No experimental trees, failed trajectories, rejected branches, synthesized SFT/preference datasets, or checkpoints are released. Finally, the evidence is math-only, the over-30% claim depends on the reported models and token budgets, and the 3.9-point headline combines FastMCTS SFT with Branch-DPO.

监督契约弱于标签名称所暗示的含义。验证提示主要检查终局答案是否一致，偏好配方还假设终局正确意味着此前每一步都正确。零分节点可能只是探索不足，而非推理错误；生成器与验证器同属一个模型，相关错误可能通过全票判断；无上限的共识重试还会影响成本与终止。前缀复用虽节省生成，却可能让轨迹更相关并降低多样性，作者也把这一点列为未解决问题。

数据谱系并不完整。英语来源比例、中文网页 URL 与权利、条目清单、语义去污染、种子、切分和论文运行哈希均不可得。代码仓库没有许可证，依赖未锁定，示例设置也不能复现论文主配置。实验树、失败轨迹、拒绝分支、合成 SFT/偏好数据和检查点都未发布。最后，证据只覆盖数学领域，“多出 30% 以上”依赖论文所用模型与 token 预算，而 3.9 分标题结果还把 FastMCTS SFT 与 Branch-DPO 合在一起。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction/open-release track, FastMCTS is a useful reference for turning a token-budgeted search process into multiple supervision views. A careful implementation can preserve source problem IDs, full tree topology, parent-child steps, prompt/few-shot revisions, generated-token counts, every judge vote and retry, backed values, accepted and rejected paths, and the exact SFT or preference objective. Those records enable audits of search-induced sampling balance and of how step labels change with additional visits.

Reuse should distinguish the released recipe code from the unreleased experimental dataset. Builders should pin a commit and dependencies, replace placeholder endpoints, publish paper-matched configs and seeds, cap and log verifier retries, and avoid calling a zero-score child “incorrect” without coverage evidence. Failed branches are valuable audit data and should be retained. Cross-domain use remains an extrapolation until verifier semantics and search behavior are tested outside mathematics.

在“数据构造与开放发布”轨道中，FastMCTS 适合作为把 token 预算搜索过程转换为多种监督视图的参考实现。严谨实现应保留源题 ID、完整树拓扑、父子步骤、提示/few-shot 版本、生成 token 数、每次评审投票与重试、回传值、接受与拒绝路径，以及准确的 SFT 或偏好目标。这样才能审计搜索造成的采样平衡变化，以及步骤标签如何随访问次数变化。

复用时必须区分已发布的配方代码与未发布的实验数据集。构建者应固定提交和依赖，替换占位服务地址，公开与论文匹配的配置和种子，为验证重试设上限并记录日志，同时避免在缺少覆盖证据时把零分子节点称为“错误”。失败分支本身是有价值的审计数据，应被保留。若迁移到数学以外领域，在重新验证评估语义和搜索行为前都只能视为外推。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1-3.4 with Appendix D to see that simulation continuations are retained as tree nodes and terminal results are backed up.
  • Read Appendices F and H together: the judge checks complete answers, while step/branch labels are inferred from terminal success and visit counts.
  • Separate the two headlines: FastMCTS SFT gains 2.9 average points in the max-16 English comparison; 3.9 points includes Branch-DPO.
  • Table 1 reports more accepted paths at slightly lower average token counts, not a universal 30% token-cost reduction.
  • Inspect the official repository as recipe code only; paper-matched configs, synthesized outputs, licenses, and stable data schemas are still missing.

• 联读第 3.1-3.4 节与附录 D，确认模拟续写如何保留为树节点，以及终端结果如何回传。
  • 联读附录 F 与 H：评估器检查完整答案，而步骤/分支标签由终端成功和访问次数推断。
  • 区分两个标题数字：英语“每题最多 16 条”对比中，FastMCTS SFT 平均提升 2.9 分；3.9 分包含 Branch-DPO。
  • 表 1 展示的是平均 token 略少且通过路径更多，不是普适的“token 成本降低 30%”。
  • 官方仓库应按配方代码理解；与论文匹配的配置、合成输出、许可证和稳定数据模式仍然缺失。
